verdict.rationale: Skyvern's browser-sessions docs say a VNC stream lets you watch or take control of a running browser at any point. Human-in-the-loop pauses are documented to preserve browser state. Together these cover both live watching and mid-run human takeover. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the takeover/handback workflow (how the agent resumes after a human intervenes), independent or hands-on corroboration of live takeover.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can watch a session live and take human control mid-run when the agent gets stuck
